svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ML platform on AWS
svg.desc: ML platform on AWS. 11 components in 3 groups. Connections: Raw data to Feature pipeline; Feature pipeline to Feature Store; Feature Store to Train; Train to Evaluate; Evaluate to Model Registry; Model Registry to Batch transform; Model Registry to Real-time endpoint; Batch transform to Predictions; Real-time endpoint to Drift alarm (captured traffic); Training pipeline to Retraining rule (start); Retraining rule to Drift alarm.

text.tspan: Features land in SageMaker Feature Store, a Step Functions pipeline trains and registers models, SageMaker serves them, and drift alarms trigger retraining
